title: A one-second delay in Structured Text
description: Wire a 16/16 PLC, a pushbutton and a lamp, then use a TON timer in Structured Text so the lamp lights one second after the button is pressed and drops out when it is released.
objectives: Wire the button to an input and the lamp to an output of the PLC
Name the tags in the I/O panel and write the program
The lamp is still off at 0.5 s, on after 1.5 s, off again after release
hints: Declare the timer in VAR: tm : TON;
Call it every scan: tm(IN := Go, PT := T#1s); then Lamp := tm.Q;
Remember the PLC needs its own 24 V on L+ and M
